Context: 7. Leave Entitlements for Vacation Department Staff

7. Vacation can be combined with any kind of leave; but the duration of vacation and earned leave combined should not exceed the amount of EL due and admissible. - Proviso to Rule 28 (2).
8. Vacation can be combined with casual leave. - GID (3), Rule 28.
9. The facility of crediting unavailed portion of joining time under Rule 26 (1) (a) (ii) is also admissible to persons serving in Vacation Departments. - Note below Rule 28 (3).
